question: Can the prior cross-work 13SU solar correction be reconstructed from one authenticated Ming print, without transferring Jiaoshi coefficients or Kyoto YuanShi limits into it?

source.work: 周相《大明大統曆法》卷六公開影像
source.edition_scope: 隆慶三年1569 reprint attribution; computational epoch1477 and digital surrogate2019 are separate; no new physical impression identification
source.review: Manual source-image reading, no OCR. JPEG extracted without resampling from the PDF image XObjects using PyMuPDF; RGB hashes and boxes use native dimensions. Enlargements aid viewing only. Folio/page binding is the public PDF sequence, not independently read original foliation.

original_method.heading: 推盈縮差度分法
short_atoms: 復加其下盈縮積度全分
original_method.scope: The printed procedure uses the fractional remainder, the corresponding daily addend and accumulated correction. It does not instruct evaluation of continuous C(n+f). No final six-place rounding/discard clause is asserted from this page.
original_limit_strings: 八十八日九千〇九十二分二十五秒
九十三日七千一百二十〇分二十五秒
original_method.radix_bridge: Existing source-local fixed-point reconstruction MING-DATONG-1569-YINGSUO-FULL-NUMERIC-RECONSTRUCTION-R1: day remainder/10000, source numeric fen/10000 gives degrees. This is the 1569 source bridge only, not G893 少=微.
original_method.abbreviation_boundary: The last columns abbreviate previously established ten-thousands/thousands. Normalized C strings use the full printed table context and existing source-local reconstruction; they are not verbatim uninterrupted glyph strings in the narrow endpoint boxes.

exact_replay.single_copy_result: The same 1569 PDF supplies both seasonal limit inputs, the original interpolation operator and endpoint C/M values. Both corrections exactly equal the prior 13SU cross-work mathematical predictions.
exact_replay.G893_comparison_boundary: 89+I and 94-I are hypothetical mappings to G893 full-degree aggregate windows, not a 1569 printed aggregate calculation. The explicit G893 full totals remain 91.401427/91.598717; the mismatches survive positive truncation or half-up final six-place rendering.
exact_replay.precision_boundary: Six fractional places in a time/day input are not six-place angular output precision. Original displayed fen precision and an exact modern rational replay do not certify ancient retained intermediates or G893 prose generation.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: A Ming single-copy procedural witness is not proof that G893 used it or that the G893 aggregate prose was generated from its daily table.
Numeric equality with 13SU does not establish direct copying between the 1569 print, Jiaoshi and Kyoto YuanShi.
remaining_questions: G893 source-native same-field retained precision/carry or genuinely independent original aggregate generator remains needed.

next: Seek direct G893 carry/generation or an independent original angular aggregate at five-plus/six places. The 1569 single-copy interpolation alternative has now been screened; do not repeat cross-work operator/limit confirmations as fresh G893 progress.
